subject: GCP Private Offer — consumption gating, billing tags, and drawdown sequencing (HelixData)
messages:
From: Amaya Ruiz <amaya@helixdata.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelixData Q4 forecast + private offer ask

Hi Marissa / Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We reviewed the draft private offer and have two operational asks before we sign:

1) Consumption gating: our finance team needs a mechanism to prevent over-redemption in the first 60 days while we ramp. Can Redwood gate drawdown to a labeled billing account or SKU bucket so we can control pace?

2) Billing tags: we need resource-level labels injected so our internal chargeback reports map to our business units. Can you confirm which labels the private-offer flow will honor and whether they can be enforced during the first month?

Attached is our updated forecast for Q4 and the high-level PO timing (Helix_Forecast_Q4.xlsx). We’re aiming to finalize by the 15th; happy to sign earlier if gating is confirmed.

Best,
Amaya Ruiz
Head of Procurement, HelixData
procurement@helixdata.com

Attachments: Helix_Forecast_Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet, forecast)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amaya Ruiz <amaya@helixdata.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixData Q4 forecast + private offer ask

Thanks Amaya — this is straightforward to support. Quick answers inline and an ops proposal below.

On Tue, Oct 6, 2026 at 9:12 AM Amaya Ruiz <amaya@helixdata.com> wrote:
> 1) Consumption gating: our finance team needs a mechanism to prevent over-redemption in the first 60 days while we ramp. Can Redwood gate drawdown to a labeled billing account or SKU bucket so we can control pace?
>
> 2) Billing tags: we need resource-level labels injected so our internal chargeback reports map to our business units. Can you confirm which labels the private-offer flow will honor and whether they can be enforced during the first month?

Proposal (ops):
- Create a dedicated billing account for the private-offer slices and add a required label prefix helix:team=<BU>. Our provisioning pipeline can reject redemptions not including that prefix.
- Implement a soft cap for the first 60 days (drawdown window) at 30% of the committed monthly rate; ops will review weekly and approve incremental releases via a small pull request on the private-offer control plane.
- If HelixData prefers, we can map SKU groups (e.g., inference_g1, inference_g2) to the commit bucket and set per-SKU throttles.

I’ve attached the private offer template and internal tagging guidance to make the gating config explicit (private_offer_template.pdf, tagging_guidelines.md).

Next steps: Marcus / Ops — can you confirm the billing export query and the scheduled job to surface weekly remaining commit?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: private_offer_template.pdf, tagging_guidelines.md
From: Amaya Ruiz <amaya@helixdata.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixData Q4 forecast + private offer ask

Marissa — perfect, that approach should work for finance. A couple follow-ups:

- We can create the dedicated billing account and will apply the helix:team labels at resource creation. Can you share the exact label key/value schema you expect so our infra automation can emit them consistently?
- For the soft cap, is the approval via the private-offer control plane or do you need a signed DocuSign to increment the window? We can toggle via API if you prefer speed.

I attached a signed NDA we had in place earlier this year; happy to countersign anything specific to the offer.

Would appreciate a short Ops runbook showing the weekly check (even a short SQL snippet) so our billing team can validate the numbers.

Thanks —
Amaya

Attachments: signed_NDA.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Amaya Ruiz <amaya@helixdata.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixData Q4 forecast + private offer ask

Thanks Amaya — good timeline. Internal ops notes and action items below; copying engineering/finance owners.

On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 10:05 AM Amaya Ruiz <amaya@helixdata.com> wrote:
> - We can create the dedicated billing account and will apply the helix:team labels at resource creation. Can you share the exact label key/value schema you expect so our infra automation can emit them consistently?
> - For the soft cap, is the approval via the private-offer control plane or do you need a signed DocuSign to increment the window? We can toggle via API if you prefer speed.

Operational plan (short):
1) Tagging schema: helix:team, helix:env, helix:project. Values must be URL-safe strings (no spaces). We'll provide a small JSON schema but the minimal requirement is helix:team=<BU>.
2) Enforcement: Redwood ops will reject redemptions without the required label prefix during the first 60 days. After 60 days the label check becomes advisory.
3) Drawdown cadence: set initial soft cap = 30% of monthly commit; weekly cron job will compute remaining commit and surface via the GCP export. If Helix requests a release, we will accept API request signed by an authorized email (procurement@helixdata.com) and elevate the cap in our control plane (no DocuSign required for intra-month increments).
4) Billing export: ops to schedule a daily export to a HelixData-shared BigQuery dataset (read-only) named helix_billing_shared.dataset. I’m attaching the example query we’ll run (billing_export_query.sql).

Action items:
- Helix: create dedicated billing account and confirm initial BU label mapping (due: 2026-10-12) — Amaya
- Redwood (Marissa/Marcus): push tagging schema and enable initial gating on staging (due: 2026-10-14) — marissa_cole / marcus_lin
- Redwood Ops (Priyom): schedule daily export & weekly remaining-commit report (due: 2026-10-15) — priyom_das

I attached a short runbook for the drawdown process (drawdown-runbook.md) and the SQL we’ll use for the daily export. I will set up a 30-minute sync next Tuesday to confirm the webhook and API keys.

Thanks — we’ll aim to have gating enabled in staging by 10/14 and production controls by 10/18 so you can sign the private offer and start redemptions.

Marcus Lin
Head of Marketplace Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: billing_export_query.sql, drawdown-runbook.md
